extraction.Name: Louisa Ross
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 13, 1918, by Volz Abstract Co.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the Security Bank, Winner, for $1200; conveyed by deed to Harry L. Carlson for $3000, subject to the mortgage of $3200 which the grantee assumed and agreed to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612737 issued; Southwest quarter of section 1, township 95, north of range 77; land mortgaged by allottee in February 1918; receipt for patent signed by the allottee; on March 31, 1925, Louisa Ross conveyed by deed to Harry L. Carlson for $3000, subject to mortgage of $3200 which grantee assumed and agreed to pay
